t: What is said to you afterwards
a: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُم بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ ۚ فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَى ٱلدَّارِ
p: Salāmun ʿalaykum bimā ṣabartum, fa-niʿma ʿuqba-d-dār.
m: "Peace [i.e., security] be upon you for what you patiently endured. And excellent is the final home."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
